title: The manifest
style: cinematic horror film still, old car ferry crossing a black harbor at night, thick drifting sea fog, sodium deck lights, wet steel, rope and rust, cold teal and amber tones, dramatic moody lighting, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 3. Owen finds out who his extra passengers are. One of them is family. 📜

Original fiction. Part 4 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: every night, Owen's ferry arrived with one extra soaked passenger, and the first one came back to say almost everyone was home.
scenes.image: woman in a wet wool coat walking away into fog on a dock

scenes.narration: On his day off, Owen goes to the harbor museum. In a back room, there's a wall about the old ferry. The one before this one.
scenes.image: dim small maritime museum room with old ship photographs, a brass bell and a ship's wheel on the wall

scenes.narration: January 1961. Same route. Same 11:40 crossing. Same fog. The ferry Calloway went down a mile from shore.
scenes.image: old black-and-white photograph of a small wooden ferry at a dock, passengers waving from the rail

scenes.narration: Twenty-four passengers lost. No survivors. Most were never recovered.
scenes.image: close-up of an old brass ship's bell, green with age, in a glass museum case

scenes.narration: There's a framed wall of passenger photos. Owen studies the faces. The old man in the tweed cap. The young man in the pea coat. The woman in the wool coat, smiling.
scenes.image: wall of small framed vintage portrait photographs of men and women from the early sixties, a young man studying them

scenes.narration: Every face he's seen on his ramp is on this wall.
scenes.image: close-up of a young man's shocked face reflected in the glass of an old framed portrait

scenes.narration: He counts them. Twenty-three. One still out there.
scenes.image: deckhand's finger hovering over a row of old framed photographs, one frame empty

scenes.narration: The last frame is empty. No photo. Just the crew position underneath. The ship's deckhand, Elias Pike.
scenes.image: single empty picture frame on a museum wall, a faint pale rectangle where a photo used to be

scenes.narration: Owen's grandfather. The family never talked about him. Owen always thought he'd run off.
scenes.image: faded family snapshot of a smiling young man in a deckhand's cap on a ferry rail, nineteen-sixties

scenes.narration: That night, Marta watches Owen a long time before they cast off. The last one's always the hardest, she says. They don't want to leave the boat. And tonight, he's on it.
scenes.image: captain and deckhand facing each other on a foggy ferry deck at night, mooring lines being cast off
